name: Symbol hunt
description: Find and tap every symbol that matches the model. Trains selective attention and visual exploration of space.
instructions:
The box contains many symbols.
Tap all the ones that are the SAME as the model shown at the top. If you make a mistake, tap it again to undo.
When you think you have found them all, press "I'm done".
instructionsKids:
Find all the little fish 🐟 hidden in the sea and tap them!
When you have found them all press "I'm done".
printInstructions: Circle every symbol that matches the model. Work calmly, without stopping.
